ruling.details: Disagreement located: the native reference-centered ordered triplet survives (successfully keeps identical terms distinct through relational roles without collapse or indexing, and operates as an irreducible ternary unit), but standard mathematical representations fail. Posets and categories collapse identical terms without numbering/indexing, and binary reduction to pairs loses the joint complementary dependency relative to the reference.
